description: One table for the rule that recognises a DianDian reply that lost text where list items were joined: a '- ' list marker straight after a full stop, comma, colon or exclamation mark in the middle of a line. The Python rule is tested against all of it. The damaged passages are short stretches taken verbatim from saved replies (zero-width spaces included), cut around the join; they hold no note ids and no whole reply. The normal passages are real too, except where 'why' says it was written by hand; no saved reply keeps dash list markers (the page text drops them), so the proper-list case has to be hand-written. Damaged passages marked constructed say so in 'why'.
